chunks: "If your brother says to you, after you have come out of the bathhouse, 'May your bath be pleasant,' then say: 'May Allah bless your state.'"

key_terms.أَنْعَمَ: may He bless or bestow favor
key_terms.طَابَ: may it be pleasant or wholesome

ai.seo_question: What should one reply when someone says 'May your bath be pleasant' after leaving the bathhouse?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a courteous verbal exchange between believers after leaving the bathhouse. It reflects Islamic etiquette in social interaction and encourages responding to a kind remark with a good supplication.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.298 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"If your brother says to you after you come out of the bath, 'May your bath be pleasant,' then reply with, 'May Allah (swt) grant you well-being.'"
